title: Hover and press micro interactions
when: The user wants buttons, cards and links to feel responsive with hover, press, toggle and copied or saved feedback.
inputs: the accent color and shadow tokens
prompt:
Goal: Small, fast state changes on every interactive element that confirm hover, press and completion without slowing anyone.
Steps:
1. List interactive elements and give each a rest, hover, active, focus-visible and disabled look.
2. Hover: one subtle change (background one step darker, or a thicker underline), inside @media (hover: hover) so touch screens do not keep sticky hover.
3. Press: :active with transform: scale(0.98) or translateY(1px) over 80 to 120 ms so taps feel physical.
4. Card hover: translateY(-2px) and the next shadow token, with one stretched link (::after inset 0) making the whole card clickable.
5. Copy or toggle feedback: swap the label (Copied) for 1.5 s and announce it in an aria-live="polite" region.
6. Wrap movement in a prefers-reduced-motion rule; keep the color feedback when motion is off.
Quality bar:
- Feedback starts within 100 ms.
- Focus and hover look different.
- No layout shift on hover.
Pitfalls:
- Actions that only appear on hover.
- Slow 500 ms button transitions.
- Bolding text on hover, which shifts the line.
Verify:
- [ ] Each interactive class has hover, active and focus-visible rules.
- [ ] Hover rules sit in @media (hover: hover).
- [ ] A reduced motion rule exists.
- [ ] Feedback text reaches a live region.
Output: Interaction states in style.css and the small feedback script, if any.

examples.input: make the cards and buttons feel more alive
examples.output: hover lift 2px with shadow-2, press scale 0.98 at 100ms, Copied label for 1.5s announced politely
